intro.title: A forest cabin near Bachevo. A small village in the Rhodopes.
intro.body: We build and host places for people who want to be out in nature. Choose a private cabin for two, or stay among the A-frames and stone buildings of The Valley. No hotel corridors. Just the mountains, and room to spend the days your way.

cabin.title: The Cabin
cabin.body: A private forest stay for two near Bachevo. No guest Wi-Fi, a wood stove, and a wood-fired hot tub. High clearance is recommended on the forest road.

aframe.title: The Valley · A-frame
aframe.body: A compact cabin for two, with the meadow, fire pit and mountain paths outside. Starlink is in the Stone House, not in the A-frame.

lux.title: The Valley · Luxury Cabin
lux.body: A private cabin for two, with the shared Valley outside. Starlink is in the Stone House, not inside the Luxury Cabin. The standard rate is €110 a night.

stone.title: The Valley · Stone House
stone.body: A house for up to six, with room to gather and Starlink inside. A bigger group needs more than one stay, or the whole Valley.

buyout.title: The whole Valley
buyout.body: Seven stays for up to 18 overnight guests: five A-frames, the Luxury Cabin and the Stone House. Rooming and the price depend on your dates. Catering and meeting equipment are not included.

itinerary.arrivalCabin: Drive to the park-and-walk point we send after booking. Do not navigate to the building. Settle in, light the wood stove if you want the cabin warm, and leave the evening open. Check-in is from 15:00.
itinerary.arrivalValley: Park in Chereshovo, then walk about 2.5 km (around 45 minutes) or use an arranged transfer. We send the route after booking. Settle into your stay. Check-in is from 15:00.
itinerary.dayCabin: Spend the day outside. If you want the wood-fired hot tub in the evening, start the fire early — it takes several hours to heat.
itinerary.dayValley: Walk from the village, then use the shared fire pit or the outdoor wood-fired hot tub if they are free. Bring the food you want to cook.
itinerary.dayBuyout: A slow morning, time on the meadow, and an evening at the fire pit if the weather allows. Each group keeps their own place to sleep.
itinerary.openDay: Leave this day open: read, walk or rest. Nothing else is scheduled, and extra activities are not included.
itinerary.departure: A quiet morning and check-out by 11:00, unless a later departure was agreed in advance.
itinerary.oneNight: These stays are set up with a two-night minimum. Confirm that on the calendar before you travel.

story.eyebrow: From the people who built it
story.title: We didn't find these places. We made them.
story.body: Drift & Dwells started with The Cabin in the forest. Then came The Valley, built one cabin and one shared space at a time. We know the roads, the weather and the small details because we are here doing the work.
story.imageAlt: Jose at The Valley, Drift & Dwells

philosophy.eyebrow: One Bulgarian word we keep coming back to
philosophy.definition1: The art of not being in a hurry. A Bulgarian word for taking the day as it comes.
philosophy.definition2: The reason these places exist: enough quiet, and enough time, to stop rushing.

faq.title: The things you'll probably want to know.
faq.body: These are remote places. Getting here is part of the stay, and it helps to know what to expect.

where.q: Where are The Cabin and The Valley?
where.a: The Cabin is near Bachevo, in the Razlog area. The Valley is near Chereshovo, in the Rhodope Mountains. Both are in southwestern Bulgaria.

drive.q: Can we drive all the way to the door?
drive.a: At The Cabin, drive to the park-and-walk point we send after booking. The last stretch is a rough forest road and high clearance is recommended. Do not follow a pin that lands on the building. At The Valley, park in Chereshovo. The final approach is about 2.5 km, around a 45-minute walk, or an arranged transfer.

wifi.a: There is no guest Wi-Fi at The Cabin, and the mobile signal may be weak or absent. At The Valley, Starlink is in the Stone House only — not in the A-frames or the Luxury Cabin.

group.q: Can we book for a family or a company?
group.a: Yes. The Valley has seven stays and room for up to 18 overnight guests when all of them are free: five A-frames for two, the Luxury Cabin for two, and the Stone House for up to six. Meals, facilitation and meeting equipment are not included with a private hire.

times.q: What time is check-in and check-out?
times.a: Check-in is from 15:00. Check-out is by 11:00. A later departure has to be agreed before you travel.

gift.q: Can I give someone a stay?
gift.a: Yes. Gift vouchers start at €15 of prepaid credit, last 12 months from issue, and can be sent by email or as a physical card. The recipient uses the credit on an available stay at The Cabin or The Valley.

voucher.title: Give someone a trip they'll actually look forward to.
voucher.body: Choose an amount, add their name and a note, and send it by email or as a physical card. They decide which place to book, and when.
voucher.imageAlt: Drift & Dwells gift voucher card preview
